description:
Upload a CSV to the List Evaluator, which estimates a list's quality from a sample and uses no credits.
When to use: When the user wants a quick quality estimate of a list before spending credits to validate it.
Parameters: fileContent — CSV text; fileName — e.g. list.csv; emailAddressColumn — 0-based column of the email addresses.
WRITE: Changes ZeroBounce account data (uploads, deletes, filters, tests, batch validation, warmup settings). Confirm with the user before calling.
name: send_list_evaluator_file
title: Evaluate a list
